info.title: barkcli REST API
info.description: REST API for barkcli — git-native project management. All board data is stored as YAML files in your repository.

get.description: Returns all board names in the project.

post.description: Create a new board with a title, description, and columns.

columns.description: Custom columns (default: todo, doing, review, done)

delete.description: Delete a board and its associated files.

get.description: Returns the YAML content of a board.

post.description: Add a comment to a specific card.

get.description: Returns the operation history for a board.
Returns captured agent sessions.
Returns the code context mapping for cards.

post.description: Git-aware refresh of code context. Updates file statuses based on git state.
Clear all code context for a board.

get.description: Search for symbols and files in the codebase.
Returns the current barkcli configuration.
Returns all tasks in the management queue.

post.description: Create a new task in the management queue.

get.description: Returns a specific task by ID.

delete.description: Delete a task from the queue.

post.description: Claim a task for an agent to work on.
Mark a task as completed.
Mark a task as failed.

get.description: Returns all registered agents.

post.description: Register a new coding agent.

get.description: Returns details of a specific agent.
Returns the current status of an agent.

post.description: Run a single orchestration cycle to assign pending tasks to available agents.

get.description: Returns the current orchestration state.
List or search memory entries.

post.description: Add a new memory entry.

delete.description: Delete a memory entry by ID.

get.description: Returns memory usage statistics by tier.

post.description: Add a project fact (convention, pattern, decision, preference).

get.description: List all project facts.
List all specs for a board.

post.description: Create a new specification.

get.description: Get a specific spec with its requirements.

post.description: Add a requirement to a spec.

get.description: Get traceability view for a spec (requirements to code/tests/tasks).
Get coverage report across all specs.

post.description: Scan all specs for requirements that reference outdated code.

get.description: List all checkpoints for a board.

post.description: Save a manual checkpoint of the current board state.
Restore a board to a previous checkpoint.
Revert the last operation on a board.

get.description: Show diff from the last checkpoint.
Show change history for a specific card.

post.description: Save a named snapshot of the current board state.

get.description: Export a board in YAML or JSON format.

post.description: Import a board from YAML or JSON data.

get.description: Validate all board files for structural correctness.

post.description: Auto-fix common board issues.
